name: rust
install_steps: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev cmake curl xz-utils python3 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

curl -fLsS https://static.rust-lang.org/dist/rust-1.96.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.xz -o /tmp/rust.tar.xz && echo 'd29ccb1559a177c4e72291f6e5f629de7fe8885e7521ca47802627544b121e95  /tmp/rust.tar.xz' | sha256sum -c - && mkdir /tmp/rust-install && tar -xJf /tmp/rust.tar.xz -C /tmp/rust-install --strip-components=1 && /tmp/rust-install/install.sh --prefix=/opt/rust --components=rustc,rust-std-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu,cargo,rustfmt-preview,clippy-preview --disable-ldconfig && for tool in rustc rustdoc cargo rustfmt cargo-fmt cargo-clippy clippy-driver; do ln -s /opt/rust/bin/$tool /usr/local/bin/$tool; done && rm -rf /tmp/rust.tar.xz /tmp/rust-install
